prerequisites: None. Competencies taught in the basic modules for Practical Informatics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students have basic knowledge and skills in the area of business core systems.
Students know the theoretical principles of business core systems and selected applications.
Students are able to apply working methods from business informatics.
Students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Product Lifecycle Management including Product Data Management
assessment_rules: Students must achieve at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments. Grading is from 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Business Informatics degree program. The final examination is either a written exam or an oral individual examination.
